announcements.title: 2027 proposed training fees
announcements.description: KASA has prepared proposed tuition and package costs for AGRI-SPORT pathways and selected independent short courses.
announcements.body: The KASA 2027 proposed fee schedule distinguishes tuition costs from optional accommodation and food. All fee amounts remain proposals until confirmed by KASA. Before paying, verify the currently published course page, invoice and official payment instructions. CDF sponsorship is a government-funded payment route subject to independent official approval.

announcements.title: AGRI-SPORT curriculum framework
announcements.description: An integrated agriculture and sports curriculum has been proposed for foundation and applied learners.
announcements.body: The proposed KASA AGRI-SPORT framework outlines a three-month foundation pathway with 360 contact hours and a six-month applied pathway with 720 contact hours. The KASA completion certificate is distinct from external TEVETA, FAZ and athletics federation awards. Refer to the programmes pages for the current descriptions and requirements.

announcements.title: CDF sponsorship and document checks
announcements.description: Students considering government CDF sponsorship should prepare and retain the required evidence.
announcements.body: CDF sponsorship is a government-funded pathway to pay for eligible training. Students must follow the officially prescribed constituency process. KASA checks required documents and verifies official sponsorship approval; an acceptance letter alone does not guarantee a CDF bursary. KASA's admission window and internal documentation checklist are maintained by its administrators.
